companyAnnouncements: SCALE: 230 universities, ~1.15M students — every change affects national infrastructure.
BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY MANDATORY: api-legacy CUBA format must not break.
All endpoints MUST have: Swagger annotations + integration test + unit test (70% coverage).
Database changes ONLY via Liquibase migrations with mandatory rollback file.
NEVER modify hemishe_* legacy tables structure (ALTER/DROP/RENAME forbidden).
JPA entities: use @Getter @Setter (NOT @Data) — equals/hashCode triggers N+1.
@Cacheable on private methods does NOT work (Spring AOP self-invocation).
External integrations: Resilience4j (timeout/retry/CB) tavsiya — hozir AbstractGovernmentApiService RestTemplate'siz protection. Yangi integratsiyada qo'shish.
Tests: prefer real shared dev DB (5-year CUBA data) + @Transactional rollback isolation. Testcontainers only for app-level integration tests.
Modern Spring 6.x: @MockitoBean (not @MockBean), RestClient (not RestTemplate), JdbcClient (not JdbcTemplate) for new code.
Spring Modulith 1.4.0 in use — ModularityTests verifies module boundaries. Don't break dependency graph.
JWT: TokenBlacklistService + Redis already implemented. Future enhancement: jti claim + kid header + refresh rotation (see security/CLAUDE.md 2.2).
BCrypt strength factor: 12 minimum (OWASP 2025); consider Argon2id for new services.
Java 25 features: prefer records for DTOs, pattern matching for switch.
